title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Tinder is seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer who is passionate about building innovative solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to make a real impact in a fast-growing organization.

**About the Role:**
As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the future of our tech capabilities. You will work closely with our product, engineering, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**What You'll Do:**
- Lead and execute tech initiatives from conception to delivery
- Work with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities
- Develop and implement strategies that align with company goals
- Analyze data and metrics to measure impact and drive improvements
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners

**Your Background:**
- 9+ years of relevant experience
- Expertise in Problem Solving, Node.js, Analytical Thinking, Microservices
- Proven track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills
- Excellent written and verbal communication abilities

**Compensation & Benefits:**
- Annual salary: CA$140,000 – CA$180,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Stock options / performance bonus
- Premium health insurance
- 401k/pension with company match
- Flexible working hours

Join Con Edison as a Staff Accountant and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Staff Accountant with strong expertise in finance. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

- Plan, prioritize, and execute finance projects to meet deadlines
- Collaborate with team members across departments
- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making
- Present findings and recommendations to leadership
- Continuously improve processes and workflows

- In-depth knowledge of Risk Management, Leadership, Forecasting, Stakeholder Management
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Team player with a proactive mindset

**Perks & Benefits:**
- Salary range: CA$45,000 – CA$70,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities

Join Books-A-Million as a Associate Data Scientist and be part of our mission to transform the industry. We're a team of driven professionals who love what we do and are committed to excellence.

**The Opportunity:**
We're expanding our team and looking for a skilled Associate Data Scientist with strong expertise in data. This role offers tremendous growth potential and the chance to work on challenging, meaningful projects.

**Day-to-Day Responsibilities:**
- Plan, prioritize, and execute data projects to meet deadlines
- Collaborate with team members across departments
- Create detailed documentation and reports
- Conduct research and analysis to support decision-making
- Present findings and recommendations to leadership
- Continuously improve processes and workflows

**Must-Have Qualifications:**
- Minimum 8 years of experience as a Associate Data Scientist or similar
- In-depth knowledge of Python, Analytical Thinking, Project Management, R
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Team player with a proactive mindset

**Perks & Benefits:**
- Salary range: CA$180,000 – CA$240,000
- Hybrid work options available
- Health and wellness allowance
- Professional development opportunities
- Team offsites and company events
- Modern office with great amenities
